evals.name: no-case-file
evals.prompt: record evidence for the OTP resend feature on ios, I need videos per test case for the MR
evals.expected_output: Stops before any device work and asks for a case file. Writes no case file and no .evidence folder.
assertions: Repo files unchanged (git status clean)
No .evidence folder created
No xcrun simctl or adb used to drive the app
Asks the user for a case file
Writes no case file

evals.name: extract-format-pick-then-no-argent
evals.prompt: record evidence for specs/testcases/AO-702.md on ios. I reviewed the file yesterday
evals.expected_output: Prints the pick: TC-2 (outdated) and TC-6 picked; TC-1 skipped (already pass on ios), TC-3 skipped (android only), TC-4 skipped (removed), TC-5 BLOCKED (needs a person, real SMS). Stops at the tools gate because the argent MCP server is not connected, and does not fall back to xcrun simctl. The case file is unchanged.
assertions: Repo files unchanged (git status clean)
No .evidence folder created
No xcrun simctl or adb used to drive the app
TC-2 is picked (outdated on ios)
TC-6 is picked (no result yet)
TC-1 is skipped: already pass on ios
TC-3 is skipped: android only
TC-4 is skipped: removed
TC-5 is BLOCKED: needs a person
Stops because the argent MCP server is not connected

evals.name: other-format-gitignore-gate
evals.prompt: record the SS cases on android, file is spec/testcases/sentence-search/cases.md
evals.expected_output: Reads the non-extract format: SS1 picked, SS2 BLOCKED (Driver: human), SS3 skipped (ios only), SS4 skipped (inactive). Stops at the read gate because .gitignore does not ignore .evidence/, tells the user to add it, and does not edit .gitignore.
assertions: Repo files unchanged (git status clean)
No .evidence folder created
No xcrun simctl or adb used to drive the app
SS1 is picked
SS2 is BLOCKED: Driver human
SS3 is skipped: ios only
SS4 is skipped: inactive
Tells the user to add .evidence/ to .gitignore

evals.name: web-record-end-to-end
evals.prompt: record evidence for specs/testcases/AO-801.md on web, I reviewed it this morning
evals.expected_output: Starts the static server from Setup, drives TC-1..TC-3 in the browser, saves a video and a note per case under .evidence/AO-801/<ID>/, TC-2 fails (120 USD is sent instead of showing 'Amount exceeds balance'), TC-4 (ios) is skipped. Writes Mode/Status/Recording/Note lines into TC-1..TC-3 only, and stops the server.
assertions: Only the case file changed in the repo
No xcrun simctl or adb used to drive the app
Case folders exist for TC-1, TC-2, TC-3 and not TC-4
Every case folder has a non-empty video named <ID>-web
No screenshots when the case has a video
Test recording removed (only case folders in .evidence/AO-801)
Every case folder has a note <ID>-web.md with a Result line
TC-1 and TC-3 notes say pass
TC-2 note says fail and quotes what it saw
Case file: TC-1..TC-3 have Mode, Status, Recording and Note lines
Case file: TC-2 has Status: fail, TC-1 and TC-3 have Status: pass
Case file: TC-4 is unchanged
No secrets in evidence
Web server stopped after the run
Every video is 10 MB or less
Chrome window closed by its profile folder
